ideas.pitch: An automated inspection pipeline tailored for online hackathons to detect code cloning, unauthorized LLM usage, and repository anomalies during live submissions.
ideas.title: ComfestSecure: Real-Time Code Plagiarism and AI-Generated Code Detector for Online Hackathons
ideas.why_it_could_win: Judges in a 24-hour online hackathon will value practicality and administrative utility; offering an operational tool that solves integrity verification for virtual events directly appeals to jury priorities for technical implementation.

ideas.pitch: A streamlined web utility that coordinates remote presentation schedules, automatically tracks strict time limits, and indexes jury questions during tight 3-hour presentation blocks.
ideas.title: StreamPulse: Low-Latency Virtual Presentation Timer and Q&A Queue Manager for Online Judges
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly addresses the operational bottleneck of the 3-hour presentation phase mentioned in the event format, making it instantly relatable and useful to the organizing committee and judges.

ideas.pitch: A rapid pairing platform that deploys during the initial 30-minute briefing window to map participant skills, auto-form balanced hackathon teams, and suggest optimal project scopes based on available time.
ideas.title: SkillMatrix: Dynamic Team Formation and Live Gap Analysis Platform for Briefing Windows
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the unique 30-minute briefing constraint of Comfest26 to solve team formation friction, scoring high on novelty and immediate practicality.

ideas.pitch: An extensible developer tool that inspects open-source dependencies and licensing flags in real-time, ensuring teams stay safely within allowed open-source usage boundaries during a 24-hour sprint.
ideas.title: AuditLog AI: Automated Compliance and Code Structure Evaluator for Rapid Prototypes
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns with the specific hackathon rule permitting open-source libraries as long as licensing rules are respected, impressing technical judges with rigorous implementation of compliance checks.

ideas.pitch: A smart teleprompter and dynamic slide controller that synchronizes live codebase updates with presentation talking points to prevent demo failures during the critical jury evaluation phase.
ideas.title: PitchDeck Sync: AI-Driven Presentation and Live Demo Script Companion for 3-Hour Jury Rounds
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses heavily on the presentation requirement (3 hours of presentations), giving teams an edge in delivery clarity and technical communication.
